swimming_pool.evidence: The round above-ground pool at the right (green cover) and the oval blue pool at top-left both lie outside the yellow outline, so they belong to neighbors.

signals.notes: The house has a brown shingle roof with some uneven shading and is surrounded by tall hedges and mature trees on the north and east sides. A dark vehicle is parked in the paved driveway on the east side, and the front lawn faces the street to the south.
